events.title: Update 0.8.4: Army Orders, Naval Warfare, Court Power & Imperial Succession
events.summary: Your Majesty, this Steam Demo 0.8.4 update covers military command, naval warfare, court politics, construction and edict simulation. You can now issue orders directly from the map and manage each army's pay, training and equipment separately. Offices, factions and military command also contribute to real political power, with consequences for coups, abdication and the accession of a new ruler. events.summary: Your Majesty, version 0.8.3 is now live. events.title: 《明末力挽狂澜》 Version 0.8.0 / 0.8.1 Update Notes – Demo Now Available
events.summary: Version 0.8.0 / 0.8.1 Update Notes This update combines versions 0.8.0 and 0.8.1. It introduces map redistricting, a globe view, the Bureau of Natural Studies research system, a greatly expanded technology and policy tree, a rebuilt AI for foreign powers, bilateral diplomatic dossiers, programmatic settlement, a full visual refresh of the interface, and a large number of balance changes and fixes.
